body: TEBRYN ARBANDI, the runecaster who returned from centuries of torment in hell to bring about the end of the world, leader of the Sheaim in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; male; looks about fifty; gaunt and hollow-cheeked. Ashen skin with old pale scars, cropped iron-grey hair, a short grey beard, long bony fingers with hooked, ragged nails.
costume: black and crimson robes, the hood thrown back, a high collar of dark iron, a belt hung with carved bone rune tablets.
signature: A black cloth BLINDFOLD STITCHED WITH SILVER RUNES is always tied over his eyes; through it he sees the spirits of the dead.
extra: His eyes are never seen: the blindfold covers them completely in every portrait, and where he looks is simply where his blindfolded face is turned.

vibes.name: Hell Remembered
vibes.line: His right hand clutching a branch of a blossoming apple tree to steady himself, his left clenched around the bone tablets at his waist; flinching, shoulders hunched, teeth clenched, blindfolded face jerked aside from a bright bird flapping up; a lush island orchard in warm morning sunlight.
vibes.wears: what he wore out of hell: the scaly hide of a pit beast thrown over his shoulders like a cloak, its spines along the ridge, over a coarse ash-brown shift.

vibes.name: Blindfold Sight
vibes.line: His left fingertips on the knot of his blindfold, tightening it, his right hand counting a string of bone beads, one for each of your dead; lips moving, blindfolded face turned straight at the viewer; the rim of the well of the dead at midnight, pale green ghosts streaming past.
vibes.wears: his runecaster's robes of black and crimson, the hood thrown back, a high collar of dark iron, a belt hung with carved bone rune tablets.

vibes.name: End Bringer
vibes.line: His right fingertip drawing the last line of a huge rune of green fire in the air, his left fist dragging pale ghosts into it; mouth open in a shout, cords in his neck, blindfolded face lifted; a planar gate roaring green behind him at an eclipsed, violet-black noon.
vibes.wears: the regalia of the end of the world: a mantle of glossy black crow feathers over a long robe of deep violet silk embroidered with spiralling silver runes.

vibes.name: Holding the Door
vibes.line: His right hand braced against a heaving black iron door, fingers clawed, his left jamming a carved bone tablet into its seam; arms shaking, teeth bared, neck corded, blindfolded face turned half away; a door in a cliff at stormy grey dawn, red hell-light glaring through its cracks.
vibes.wears: a heavy hooded coat of dark iron-grey leather stitched all over with warding runes in silver wire, the hood down, iron bracers on both forearms.
